name: Analytical Tensor Glyph for Rank Two Tensors in a Plane
aliases: Analytical Tensor Glyph Visualization in a Plane
Rank two tensor component derivation in a plane
definition: A direct analytical expression for visualizing rank two tensors in a 2D plane, designed to be accurate and unambiguous, satisfying requirements such as invariance under isometric domain transformation, scaling invariance, direct encoding of real eigenvalues/eigenvectors, glyph uniqueness, and continual glyph changes.
